label: Devices
description: Keep the selected device and quick switcher visible. Device details show status, battery, network, ID and pairing; this sets whether they start expanded.

label: Quick actions
description: Show selected device shortcuts and their Ping or Text composer together. Hiding shortcuts does not change native modules.

label: File sharing
description: Choose local files to send, or drop files for review. Enable Review files before Send to review chooser selections. Hiding this section preserves the draft.

label: Native KDE Connect
description: Show native feature links in Devices. The full inventory stays available in Device features settings.

label: Media controls
description: Show reported players and media controls. Hiding this section does not stop playback.

label: Remote commands
description: Show commands configured on the selected device. A command runs only after an explicit request.

label: Connection controls
description: Show enabled VPN tool controls. Hiding or collapsing them does not connect or disconnect a VPN.

label: Saved addresses
description: Keep approved addresses available for review. Hiding this section preserves saved records and rediscovery choices.

label: Syncthing identity note
description: Show the optional local identity note and existing owner controls. Hiding it does not change Syncthing.
